name: pds-registry-loader-harvest
entryPoint: echo 'user = ' >> /etc/es-auth.cfg && echo 'password = ' >> /etc/es-auth.cfg && D=/tmp/harvest-cfg && mkdir -p $D && sed "s#\$[{]AWS_CONTAINER_CREDENTIALS_RELATIVE_URI[}]#$AWS_CONTAINER_CREDENTIALS_RELATIVE_URI#g" $(dirname $HARVEST_CFG)/connection.xml > $D/connection.xml && sed "s#file://[^<]*connection.xml#file://$D/connection.xml#" $HARVEST_CFG > $D/harvest.cfg && harvest -v DEBUG $HARVEST_EXTRA_ARGS -c $D/harvest.cfg
